About the show

Experience the original, critically acclaimed production of Tristan & Yseult – one of the most influential theatre productions of the 21st century. Adapted and directed by Emma Rice, this iconic show returns to the UK for the first time in ten years, offering a rare chance to encounter a modern...

Concessions at Citizens Theatre

Standard prices run £14–£55 in the Main Theatre and £12.50–£23.50 in the Studio. Four free memberships carry a reduced price; each needs a one-off sign-up, and none asks for ID.
